"Casino 7s" has joined the Texas lineup at $5 with four top prizes of $100,000. Only on the first day do the printed odds describe the game exactly, because nothing has been won. Starting tomorrow, this page shows how that changes.

The numbers for "Casino 7s" are recalculated every morning, and this page changes with them.
2775.headline: A brand-new game to watch

2776.body:
"Patriotic Payout" is new from the Texas Lottery. It is a $2 game with eight top prizes of $30,000. Nothing big has been won yet because almost no one has played it. This page will show it when that changes.

Everything above about "Patriotic Payout" comes from the Texas Lottery's own published numbers. We only do the counting.
